after.description: Its value after, the same way.

before.description: Its value before; null when absent. A sensitive value is a proof, {fingerprint, hint}, never the value (AUD-02).

proof.description: For a sensitive value: whether it changed, changed back to what it was before the field's previous change, or not (AUD-02).

sealed.description: For a person's personal value, sealed under their key for the event's financial year (§11.8): opened, before and after are the values; shredded, the key is gone at the end of retention and the values read null.
